chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Nadr from Hisham ibn Salim from Sulayman ibn Khalid said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the voluntary prayer on Friday. He said: 'Six rak'ahs before the sun's decline, and two rak'ahs at its decline, with the recitation in the first being Surah Al-Jumu'ah and in the second being Surah Al-Munafiqun, and after the obligatory prayer, eight rak'ahs.'
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: And the most preferable in my view is to perform all the voluntary prayers on Friday before the obligatory one.

key_terms.زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ: Decline of the sun (time for Dhuhr prayer)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended voluntary prayers and their timings on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific structure of Friday *nawafil*, prescribing six rak'ahs before the sun's decline (with Surah Al-Jumu'ah) and two at its decline (with Surah Al-Munafiqun), followed by eight after the obligatory prayer. It highlights a key jurisprudential nuance where Imam al-Tusi records a preference for consolidating all voluntary prayers before the main prayer, reflecting the scholarly tradition of optimizing worship timing. This emphasis on specific surahs connects the ritual to the thematic essence of Friday as a day of communal gathering and divine warning.
